columns.name: ICAL_FEED_ID
columns.description: Application-generated primary key

columns.name: ACTIVE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the feed is active

columns.name: PERSON_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the person associated with the feed

columns.name: SALT
columns.description: Base64-encoded 128-bit randomly generated value used to enhance the security of person id and expiration time

columns.name: TOKEN
columns.description: URL encoded security token generated when creating the feed

columns.name: EXPIRATION_TIME
columns.description: Feed or URL expiration time

columns.name: RANGE_LEFT_EXTENT
columns.description: Number of pastweeks to consider relative to the request instant

columns.name: RANGE_RIGHT_EXTENT
columns.description: Number of future weeks to consider relative the the request instant

columns.name: INCL_SHIFTS_FLAG
columns.description: Boolean indicating if the calendar content contains events corresponding to schedule shifts

columns.name: INCL_ABSENCES_FLAG
columns.description: Boolean indicating if the calendar content contains events denoting absences intersecting the datarange

columns.name: INCL_PUBLIC_HOLIDAYS_FLAG
columns.description: Boolean indicating if the calendar content contains public holidays

columns.name: FIXED_WINDOW_START_TIME
columns.description: Start time for the current fixed time window

columns.name: FIXED_WINDOW_END_TIME
columns.description: End time for the current fixed time window

columns.name: ACCESS_COUNT
columns.description: Counter used to limit access within the fixed window

columns.name: LAST_ACCESS_TIME
columns.description: When the most recent access to the ical feed was requested

columns.name: ENTERPRISE_ID
columns.description: Enterprise id or Business group id to identify in a multi tenant system

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
